title: Marine Insight — 'North Korea Begins Building Third 5,000-Ton-Class Destroyer For 2026 Launch': 3번함 남포조선소 착공, 10월 10일(당 창건일) 완성 목표, 연간 2척 건조율 실제 이행 확인
snippet: North Korea has started building its third 5,000-ton-class destroyer and plans to complete it by October 10, 2026, the founding day of the ruling Workers' Party of Korea. A rally was held at the Nampo Shipyard to mark the start of construction. Kim Jong Un reportedly said North Korea would start deploying two destroyers of the Choe Hyon class or larger every year beginning in 2026.
tag_reason: 이전 7일 소스에 3번함 착공 관련 보도 없음. 5/24 Army Recognition은 '12척 계획'을 보도했으나, 3번함의 구체적 착공 사실·장소(남포조선소)·완성 시한(10/10)은 신규 정보.
